C1_REVIEW.evidence: R19 wait/release hard failures already fail closed, but xrAcquireSwapchainImage hard failure simply returned false and retried the same broken swapchain each host frame. OpenXR 1.1.63 lists call-order, handle, instance, runtime, session and validation failures for acquire; only XR_SUCCESS and XR_SESSION_LOSS_PENDING are successful results.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: Added acquireFaulted. Hard acquire failure sets it before returning false, does not mark the image acquired/waited, Acquire rejects all image-flow fault states, EnsureSwapchain bypasses unchanged-handle reuse, and Destroy clears the fault after ownership resolution.

standards: OpenXR 1.1.63 xrAcquireSwapchainImage returns XR_SUCCESS or XR_SESSION_LOSS_PENDING on success and may fail with call-order, handle, instance, runtime, session or validation errors.
The application must successfully acquire before waiting or writing the returned image, so a failed acquire does not establish local acquired/waited ownership.
